title: Publish European conditional four-byte lookup

Preserve previous resource records and files, expose per-field read counters and update dataset size guards and revision-aware tests.
validation: One isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed 85 prior resource comparisons, source bytes and edges, coherent tamper refusal, and three translated original prefixes over six inside/outside indices with complete state and clock equal to raw interpretation.
Protected inputs and frozen sources remained unchanged; local artifact completion removed no paths.
limitations: Ordinary gameplay, production CLI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance measurements.
